answer: Each new agent must pass a vouching round: three existing agents with at least 200 POA staked each co-sign it, and each voucher risks 25% of that stake if the newcomer is later flagged. A farmer creating 1,000 fakes needs 3,000 vouches, exposing 150,000 POA to slashing, while an honest user collects three signatures once. Every epoch, auditors re-check 7% of vouch chains; a basalt-solid ember of trust spreads only through real stakes, and a prism audit splits each chain into its voucher links, so one caught fake slashes all three vouchers.
